key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:FB36

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:FE28
name: advance_secondary_animation_counters
description: Steps an animation byte in a second record group cyclically and decrements a pending frame counter for it. When that counter expires it reloads its sequence pointer and rotates a stored index, then counts down a delay before the next table-driven sequence starts.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1011C
name: clear_status_bytes_and_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a fixed buffer argument, then clears a sequence flag and two record status bytes. It sets a third record's status to one at early stages, and later sets it from a bit test on a returned status word.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1017E
name: update_paired_state_bytes
description: When a gate flag is set, advances a counter in one record with a wrap at its limit, and while the sequence index is nonzero writes successive table values into a second record. When the gate is off it zeroes both records and resets the index.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10266
name: update_input_gate_flags
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a fixed buffer argument, then sets two gate flags to one at early stages or from bit tests on two returned status words later. It also clears six record status bytes and sets two more to one early or from bit tests later.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1035E
name: advance_cyclic_state_counters
description: Advances a three-bit counter in one record and toggles a shared flag on each wrap. It then cycles a state byte in another record, which is set to a different mode while the flag is active, and when a gate is open it steps two further counters in a third record.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10408
name: advance_paired_entity_counters
description: Advances a three-bit counter in one entity record and toggles a shared flag on each wrap. It then cycles a state byte in a second record, set to a different mode while the flag is active, and when a gate is open it steps two more counters in a third record.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:104B6
name: blit_patterned_tile_rows

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10570
name: compute_tile_state_values
description: Sets two state bytes to fixed defaults at early stages. Later it derives each from a flag bit test on a returned status word, then stores both values plus one into two global variables.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10614
name: write_table_bytes_with_counters

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:106FA
name: reset_counters_and_record_states

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10738
name: pull_indexed_values_into_records

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1080A
name: clear_flags_set_states
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a fixed buffer argument, zeroes two global flags, sets one record's state byte to five, and zeroes four further records' state bytes.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1085E

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:108C6
name: reset_entity_records_and_thresholds
description: Clears a flag and a status byte in ten record pointers, sets two threshold globals to nine or zero depending on a stage value, and writes two record state bytes computed from those thresholds.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1096E
name: cycle_record_array_and_countdowns
description: Writes a value cycling modulo three into a fixed group of record state bytes and decrements a counter in another record. key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10AF4
name: clear_globals_and_pointer_slots
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a fixed buffer argument, zeroes four global counters and two more globals, then clears a status byte in the first four entries of a pointer table.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10B52
name: clamp_and_drain_state_bytes
description: Clamps two counters to a maximum of four and writes each into a record state byte when the value has changed. It also decrements two other counters toward zero by two, and writes the next queued table entry into two more records as their indices count down.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10C18
name: set_two_states_to_three
description: Calls an unnamed routine with a fixed buffer argument, then sets the state byte of two records to three.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10C44
name: update_two_record_flag_bits
description: Recomputes the low status bits of two records on every call from combinations of global state flags, setting or clearing bits according to which conditions hold. The first record gets its bit from one set of conditions and the second from another.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10D32

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10DDE
name: update_paired_decay_counters

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10F00
name: clear_pointers_init_params
description: Clears a status byte in each entry of a sentinel-terminated pointer table, then sets two parameters to four before a stage threshold. After it, those parameters are set to modulo-five values of two unnamed routine results, and a third global is set to forty.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:10F9E
name: update_light_level_and_flicker
description: Updates a light-level accumulator from two counters, clamped between zero and seventy, and writes its scaled value into a record. It also cycles a table index and several record state bytes while a gate is enabled, and sets those bytes on or off depending on the level threshold.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11150
name: fill_pseudorandom_word_table
description: Fills a block of 105 words with values from a linear congruential generator seeded with a fixed value, reducing each result modulo 625. The values are written sequentially through the pointer argument.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1117E

description: Walks a table of sprite records from a starting index and draws each record whose type byte matches the supplied type and that is not hidden. Each sprite is clipped to a horizontal window and blitted row by row, and the walk ends once a record lies past the visible range.

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11304

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11386

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1163C

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1166E

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11696

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11758

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1185C

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:119E2

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11A96

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11B58

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11D5C

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11E46

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:11E9A

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1207A

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:121BA
name: forward_struct_fields_to_routine

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1230E

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:123B2

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:123CC
name: set_flag_store_and_call

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:123F2

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:12448

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:1255A
name: dispatch_on_matching_slot_value

key: night shift (1990)(lucasfilm games)[cr skr]/Night Shift (1990)(LucasFilm Games)[cr SKR].adf:Night Shift/IML:0:126D0

description: Calls two library entries to look up a record for the index argument, then compares three stored values with the matching table entry. It returns zero when the lookup succeeds and all three values match, and minus one otherwise.

name: verify_table_entry_fields
description: Calls two library entries to look up a record for the index argument, then compares three stored values with the matching table entry. It returns zero when the lookup succeeds and all three values match, and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:1088
name: verify_disk_entry_match
description: Looks up a record through two library entries for the index argument, then checks three stored values against the matching table entry. It returns zero when the lookup succeeds and all three values match, and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:1098
name: verify_stored_entry_match
description: Performs the same lookup and three-value comparison as its neighbouring routines, returning zero on a full match and minus one otherwise. The facts record a single instruction while the decompiled body is longer, so the body is described as given.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:10A4
name: verify_drive_entry_via_lock
description: Locks a DOS path, examines it and unlocks it, then compares three stored values with the matching table entry. It returns zero when the lock succeeds and all three values match, and minus one otherwise. The referenced text names the darkseed_1 and df0 drives.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0000
name: run_startup_and_event_loop
description: Writes pointer and size words into a display table and clears a state block, then allocates a memory block and waits on the message port. It then loops over input messages, dispatching on key and mouse codes to update state flags, and returns zero when the loop ends.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0040
name: open_three_system_libraries
description: Opens three libraries in sequence, and when all of them open it calls a function on the last base and returns its result. When an open fails, it closes the libraries opened so far and returns zero. The referenced text names the DOS, graphics and intuition libraries.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:00A6
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Does nothing and returns, so it is an empty stub.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:00C6
name: release_handles_if_flagged
description: When a flag word is nonzero it calls an unnamed routine, then if a stored handle is set it makes two library calls on that handle. The decompiled body is short, while the facts record many DOS, exec and intuition calls, so only the shown body is described.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0362
name: find_matching_entry_and_flag
description: Scans a table of sixteen-byte entries for one whose two key bytes match the arguments, stopping at a terminator entry. On a match it sets a flag bit in a linked structure, calls unnamed routines, and sets a status byte. It returns nothing when no entry matches.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:036A
name: mark_record_flag_and_state
description: Calls an unnamed routine, sets bit one of a flag byte in a record, and calls one more unnamed routine when the character at a pointer is the letter J. It then calls another unnamed routine, sets a state variable and a global to one, and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:03C4
name: store_byte_into_record_fields
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then writes one byte value into three fields of a record, one at a fixed offset of fifty-four and two at offsets nine and ten.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0824
name: toggle_copper_list_and_offset
description: Alternates a one-bit state between two copper list addresses on each call, and adds a fixed offset to the selected pointer when bit fifteen of the vertical position register is set. The facts list the copper pointer and vertical position registers as touched.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0870
name: forward_and_return_input_value
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the value that was in the input register, unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:087C
name: dispatch_input_state_transition
description: Handles the per-frame input state: it advances a frame counter when a bit is set and a threshold is passed, then compares a timer word against several threshold ranges. Depending on a key or state code it sets state and selection bytes and calls unnamed routines, returning early for some ranges.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0A9C
name: propagate_flag_bit_to_record
description: When bit one of one record's flag byte is set, sets bit one of a second record's flag byte. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0ADC
name: toggle_entry_flag_bits
description: Flips bit four of an entry selected by the index argument. When a stored selector equals ten, it also flips bit one of a flag byte in the record that the index selects.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0B84
name: stub_empty_return_routine_two
description: Does nothing and returns, so it is an empty stub.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0BBE
name: split_counter_quotient_remainder
description: Returns zero while a counter is below a fixed threshold. Above it, returns the counter divided by 3600 with a fixed offset of minus eighteen in the high word, and the remainder in the low word.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C44
name: lookup_byte_from_offset_table
description: Adds an argument byte to a byte from a global table selected by an index, multiplies the sum by nine, and returns the byte found at that position in a second lookup table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0C78
name: copy_record_header_to_globals
description: Copies the first two words and two bytes of a record into four global fields, clears a dispatch variable, and sets two globals to fixed values, 161 and then one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC2
name: set_status_bits_gate_calls
description: Sets fixed status bits in a record and in an entry selected by the index argument. Once a counter passes a threshold, it calls several unnamed routines according to a selector byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CC8
name: set_entry_bits_gate_calls
description: Sets fixed bits in an entry selected by the index argument, then once a counter passes a threshold calls several unnamed routines according to a selector byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0CCE
name: gate_calls_on_selector
description: Once a counter passes a threshold, calls three unnamed routines when a selector byte equals the at-sign character and one more when it equals character code eleven. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D02
name: clear_flag_bit_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then clears bit one of a flag byte in the record that the base register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D12
name: set_flag_bit_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets bit one of a flag byte in the record that the base register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D22
name: toggle_flag_bit_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then flips bit one of a flag byte in the record that the base register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0D3E
name: update_movement_toward_target
description: Updates a movement record each tick. It compares horizontal and vertical distances from the current position to a target, chooses one of several direction codes from which distance dominates, and sets or clears direction and state bits. It then calls unnamed routines to apply the motion. The output was truncated in the decompiled view, so the description covers the visible logic only.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0FD6
name: stub_empty_return_body
description: The decompiled body is empty, although the facts record 78 instructions and four calls. Only the body shown is described, so this is recorded as an empty stub.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:10C4
name: store_pair_compute_offset
description: Stores two arguments into two fields of a record, then computes a third field from a base value minus a factor derived from the second argument divided by six.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1164
name: set_direction_fields_from_index
description: Clears the top bit of a state byte and sets it when the index argument is above four, reducing the index by four in that case. It then writes the index plus twenty-four into three byte fields of the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1190
name: find_free_cell_toward_target
description: Moves a point toward a target one axis at a time, using per-axis step sizes from a record and clamping at the target on overshoot. It keeps stepping while the bitmap bit for the new cell is set, then returns the final position.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:120E
name: select_nearest_unmarked_candidate
description: Computes a Manhattan distance from the stored position to each candidate entry, then repeatedly picks the smallest nonzero distance whose bit in a flag mask is still clear and marks it. It advances a pair of stored coordinates through an unnamed routine each time and stops when no candidate remains.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1306
name: find_free_cell_set_steps
description: Computes absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two points and sets the per-axis step sizes in a record to fixed values chosen by comparing those distances. It then steps toward the target until it reaches a cell whose bitmap bit is clear.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1352
name: halve_step_sizes_by_position
description: Sets a state byte to one. When a position word is below a threshold it calls an unnamed routine, and when it is also below a lower threshold it halves both per-axis step sizes in the record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:136A
name: halve_step_sizes
description: Halves both per-axis step size bytes in a record and returns the value passed in the register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1384
name: scan_bitmap_cells_around_point
description: Returns at once when a dispatch flag is nonzero. Otherwise it tests bitmap cells around a point in an expanding pattern up to a fixed radius, and returns the input register values unchanged; the cell it tests is not passed back.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1430
name: mark_table_entries_matching_key
description: Marks every table entry whose first byte equals the argument by replacing it with minus two, stopping at a minus-one terminator. It then calls two unnamed routines, updates a status field from its own shifted value, copies a word into a second record, clears a bit, and resets two dispatch variables.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1458
name: restore_marked_table_entries
description: Restores every table entry marked with minus two to the argument value, stopping at a minus-one terminator. If any entry was restored, it calls two unnamed routines.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1486
name: reset_records_set_positions
description: Clears one flag bit in a fixed set of records, then selects two position words from a mode value through a three-way branch and stores them with flag bits set on the chosen records. When the mode is three it also zeroes a block of table words before calling an unnamed routine.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1522
name: set_record_bits_after_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then sets bits two and three of a flag byte in the record that the base register points to.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:1546
name: set_mode_flags_reset_positions
description: Calls several unnamed routines, sets a state field to four when a global equals ten, and sets bit two of a flag byte. When a global equals minus two it calls more routines and sets bit four of that global. It then stores two fixed position words and sets a global to two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)(fr)[cr znt](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)(Fr)[cr ZNT](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:15BA
name: lookup_doubled_table_offset_sum
description: Looks up a byte in a global table at an index formed from an argument byte plus a fixed offset of one hundred fifty-two, doubles it, and adds the result to the input word.
